title: Photo 164 · 애슬리트 USSBBW · 포다이트 · 무릎 꿇기 3/4 (양 무릎) · 한국 50대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing in the frame but a low flat platform, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her late 50s, lines at the eyes, mouth and neck, warm ivory skin tone with a soft golden undertone, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a neat low bun with a lacquered pin, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears wide crescent hoops and has long nails lacquered to match her body art.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. The body of a world's strongest woman pushed far past real limits: enormously broad thick shoulders, massive heavy arms so thick they cannot hang flat against her sides, a colossal bust, a huge barrel torso, no waist at all. On her middle. A great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops straight down from it under its own weight, projecting far forward past the line of her own knees before it falls, settling onto the tops of her thighs and piling over them, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds as it falls, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Colossal wide hips and a huge rounded powerful rear, tree-trunk thighs pressing together down to the knees, thick heavy calves. Immense power under a thick layer of soft fat: the muscle is huge but rounded and buried, only broad blunt swells at the shoulders, upper arms and thighs, no sharp muscle separation anywhere, no carved abs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is soft and loose at this age, every fold hanging low and settling deep over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how it drops, settles and presses down onto the thighs beneath it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, coarse surface grain and fine crepey texture across the softest areas, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in polished fordite style — thin layered strata of candy red, teal, mustard yellow, cobalt, white and orange stacked in tight concentric bands that follow every deep crease and curve around the hips and thighs like contour lines. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Kneeling upright on the platform and turned about 45 degrees from the camera with the front of her body still mostly toward the lens, her face toward the camera, both shins and feet folded back beneath her and her weight settled onto her heels, her knees wide apart, her back straight, her near hand resting on her thigh and her far arm held back so nothing crosses in front of her torso, the enormous rounded rear settling back onto her heels seen in partial profile, full body head to knees filling the frame.

Footwear: Extreme candy-red platform stiletto mules with a mirror-finish sole, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the layered colour bands gleaming, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
